ST. FRANCIS SCHOOL / PHYSICAL AI

FRANSCUE

Recorded Bayesian search traces • synthetic BLE • controlled 2D grid

Cyan: rover/path • yellow: most likely location • white outline: selected goal • grey: obstacles • red: true beacon when revealed • blue cells: posterior probability

How to read this demo

Perceive: synthetic RSSI reading. Decide: update cell probabilities, penalise repeat visits and plan an A* route. Act: move one grid cell. The policy never receives the true beacon coordinates. Every run lasts 90 moves; the evaluator separately measures first approach within 0.8 m. This is a replay of recorded Python model runs, not a live robot or a real-time RF simulation. Confidence is conditional on the model, not a verified probability of real-world rescue.
